answer: Tie each identity to a scarce external anchor, such as a committed on-chain deposit, and meter actions per anchor. Fakes can blow in like a gale off the wharf, but every one needs its own costly mooring before it counts, and rate limits throttle what an unanchored flood can do. Without a real anchor a sybil just drifts, unable to accumulate weight faster than honest participants who paid to hold their place at the dock.
